ActivationCode.title: ActivationCode
ActivationCode.description: License activation code generated by admin in activation_codes collection (Document ID is the code itself).

status.description: Current redemption status of the activation code.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who generated the code.

usedByUid.description: Optional UID of buyer who redeemed the code.

usedByEmail.description: Optional email of buyer who redeemed the code.

businessName.description: Optional business name of buyer who redeemed the code.

usedAt.description: Optional server timestamp when code was redeemed.

updatedAt.description: Optional server timestamp of last update.

registeredDeviceId.description: Optional legacy single bound device ID cleared during admin device reset.

registeredDeviceIds.description: Optional list of up to 2 bound device IDs cleared during admin device reset.

BuyerUser.title: BuyerUser
BuyerUser.description: Registered buyer account bound to a license code and up to 2 device IDs.

namaUsaha.description: Optional Indonesian alias for business name.

activationCode.description: Activation code redeemed by this buyer.

registeredDeviceId.description: Legacy single hardware device ID currently bound to this buyer; empty string allows login on a new phone.

registeredDeviceIds.description: List of hardware device IDs (max 2 devices) currently bound to this buyer; empty array allows login on new phones.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the buyer registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on device reset.

/activation_codes/{codeId}.description: License activation codes keyed by the code string itself (e.g. JUALAN-A1B2-C3D4).

/users/{userId}.description: Registered license buyers and their device binding state.
